notes:
• 🏷 Ticket bin / bag label: big ticket number, customer name, phone, sell / trade, what they brought and the time in, with a QR code and barcode of the ticket number. Prints by itself when you start a ticket (Tickets → 🏷 Label on start), or from the ticket (pick how many — one per bin or bag, numbered 1 of 3…) and the ticket bar
• Scan a bin label into the Tickets search box (or type BT1004 + Enter) to open that customer's ticket
• Choose the printer and roll for these labels in Settings → Printers → Ticket bin / bag labels (default: Labels printer, DYMO 30256)
